scope: Focused field and identifier map for common PubMed extraction tasks; not a full schema mirror.

citation_summary.notes: Use for screening and lightweight citation review. Verify exact response shape for the chosen retmode.

detailed_record_extraction.notes: Prefer structured output such as XML when building parsers.

identifier_collection.notes: Identifier availability varies by record and utility.

journal_metadata.notes: Use full-record retrieval when citation normalization matters.

abstract_text.notes: Do not assume abstract-bearing content is present in summary output.

related_record_lookup.notes: Coverage depends on relationship type and NCBI data availability.

pmid.common_use: Record retrieval, deduplication, and audit logging

selection_notes: Choose esummary for lightweight metadata review.
Choose efetch for richer structured record extraction.
Treat official NLM field documentation as authoritative for final field semantics.
